layers.file: File:Het voorbijrijden van een ambulance met sirene - SoundCloud - Beeld en Geluid.ogg

species: A real Dutch ambulance driving away just after passing, its siren switching between high and low notes ('nee-naw')
note: Field recording ('An ambulance passing with its siren', recorded at Crailo, the Netherlands) from the Netherlands Institute for Sound and Vision's Geluid van Nederland collection.
